method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: DeepD enables efficient genome modeling and controllable long-context sequence generation across domains of life
items.abstract_or_text: Genome foundation models hold great potential for advancing biological research, but modeling diverse complex genomes and generating controllable genome-scale sequences remain challenging. We present DeepD, a phylogeny-informed sparse mixture-of-experts model operating at single-nucleotide resolution over a 1-million-token context while reducing active computation. Pretrained on unselected whole-genome sequences across all domains of life, DeepD learns genic and intergenic sequence features and supports broad sequence-to-function prediction across species. DeepD performs well in human protein fitness and disease variants effect prediction, such as BRCA1 and BRCA2, with particular strength in regulatory regions, such as promoter and transcription-factor binding sites. Expert routing captures exon-intron boundaries, transposable elements, and distal cis-regulatory elements. DeepD also generates experimentally validated core promoters with specified transcriptional strengths. Finally, the Context-Anchor-Body strategy enables generation of complete yeast chromosome sequences and megabase-scale Arabidopsis segments, preserving gene structure and order while introducing variations within natural ranges. Together, DeepD is an efficient genome foundation model that unifies accurate sequence-to-function prediction with controllable genome-scale generation, advancing predictive and generative design of complex genomes.
items.summary_zh: Preprint：DeepD 是在所有生命域全基因组序列上训练的、具备单核苷酸分辨率和 1-million-token 上下文的稀疏 mixture-of-experts 基因组基础模型，同时支持序列到功能预测和可控的基因组级生成。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把跨物种预测、实验验证的启动子生成和兆碱基级序列生成放进同一模型，展示了复杂基因组建模与设计的统一路线。
items.abstract_zh: 基因组基础模型有望推动生物学研究，但对多样而复杂的基因组进行建模并生成可控的基因组尺度序列仍然困难。我们提出 DeepD，这是一种受系统发育信息指导的稀疏 mixture-of-experts 模型，以单核苷酸分辨率运行，支持 1-million-token 上下文，同时降低活跃计算量。DeepD 在来自所有生命域、未经筛选的全基因组序列上进行预训练，学习基因区和基因间区序列特征，并支持跨物种的广泛序列到功能预测。DeepD 在 human protein fitness 和疾病变异效应预测（例如 BRCA1 和 BRCA2）中表现良好，尤其擅长启动子和转录因子结合位点等调控区域。专家路由捕获了外显子-内含子边界、转座元件和远端 cis-regulatory elements。DeepD 还能够生成具有指定转录强度、并经实验验证的核心启动子。最后，Context-Anchor-Body 策略支持生成完整的酵母染色体序列以及兆碱基尺度的 Arabidopsis 片段，在引入自然范围内变异的同时保留基因结构和顺序。总体而言，DeepD 是一种高效的基因组基础模型，将准确的序列到功能预测与可控的基因组尺度生成结合起来，推进复杂基因组的预测性和生成式设计。
items.author_line: Lai, J., Xin, B., Wang, Z., Yu, A., Chen, Z., Guo, Y., Zhang, M., Hu, B., Ye, C., Chen, J., Liu, Q., Zhao, H., Song, W., Dong, N., Yang, F., Yang, Q., Zhao, H.

items.title: Scalable proteomics with multiDIA resolves proteoforms in neurodegenerative disease
items.abstract_or_text: Deep proteome characterization has traditionally required multidimensional chromatographic fractionation, long acquisition times and large sample amounts, thus limiting scalability. Here, we introduce multiDIA, which combines independent digestions with multiple proteases and data-independent acquisition (DIA) to increase sequence coverage without extensive chromatographic fractionation. By generating complementary and overlapping peptide representations of proteins, multiDIA identifies about 270,000 distinct peptides per sample, including 3,649 phosphosites. This is more than twice the coverage of unfractionated workflows and exceeds the coverage of multidimensional fractionation workflows that use 10-fold more material and time. We demonstrate the approach in Parkinson's disease (PD) brain samples, showing that multiDIA substantially expands sequence coverage while retaining the sensitivity, reproducibility, and scalability of DIA. This enabled the identification of disease-associated proteoform changes undetectable by single-protease DIA and the quantification of many disease-relevant post-translational modifications. MultiDIA thus enables deep, high-confidence proteome characterization from limited sample quantities without the throughput and sensitivity constraints of multidimensional fractionation.
items.summary_zh: Preprint：multiDIA 通过多蛋白酶独立消化与 data-independent acquisition 提升有限样本的蛋白质组覆盖，在 Parkinson's disease 脑样本中解析出单蛋白酶流程无法检测的 proteoform 变化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 方法在减少样本量、时间和分级分离负担的同时，将单样本覆盖提升到约 270,000 条肽段和 3,649 个 phosphosites，兼顾深度、可重复性与通量。
items.abstract_zh: 深度蛋白质组表征通常需要多维色谱分级、较长的采集时间和大量样本，因此难以扩展。这里我们引入 multiDIA，它结合独立消化、多种蛋白酶和 data-independent acquisition，在不进行大规模色谱分级的情况下提高序列覆盖率。通过生成互补且相互重叠的蛋白质肽段表示，multiDIA 每个样本可鉴定约 270,000 条不同肽段，其中包括 3,649 个 phosphosites。这一覆盖率是未分级流程的两倍以上，也超过了使用 10 倍样本量和时间的多维分级流程。我们在 Parkinson's disease 脑样本中展示了该方法：multiDIA 在保留 DIA 灵敏度、可重复性和可扩展性的同时，显著扩大了序列覆盖范围。这使我们能够鉴定单蛋白酶 DIA 无法检测的疾病相关 proteoform 变化，并定量许多疾病相关的翻译后修饰。因此，multiDIA 能够从有限样本量中进行深度且高置信度的蛋白质组表征，同时避免多维分级带来的通量和灵敏度限制。
items.author_line: Kok, O., Friedrich, C., Altig, K., Oakley, D., Hyman, B. T., Collins, M., Slavov, N.

items.title: Antibody-drug conjugate combination therapy targeting LGR5 and MET with different payloads enhances efficacy in preclinical colorectal cancer models
items.abstract_or_text: Leucine-rich repeat-containing G protein-coupled receptor 5 (LGR5) is a marker of cancer stem-like cells frequently upregulated in colorectal cancer (CRC) with lower expression in normal tissues, making it a favorable target for antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs). ADCs combine antibody specificity with potent cytotoxic payloads to enhance efficacy while minimizing systemic toxicity. LGR5-targeting ADCs incorporating different payloads demonstrate strong initial tumor inhibition, yet tumors eventually recur due in part to LGR5 downregulation, necessitating more effective strategies to prevent relapse. We show treatment with chemotherapies or an LGR5-targeting ADC coupled to a topoisomerase 1 inhibitor payload (8E11-CPT2) reduces LGR5 levels and increases MET receptor expression and/or activation in CRC cells, supporting a therapeutic approach to target LGR5 and MET simultaneously. Accordingly, we engineered a MET-targeting ADC (ABT-700-SG3199) via site-specific conjugation of the anti-MET antibody telisotuzumab (ABT-700) with the DNA-crosslinking pyrrolobenzodiazepine (PBD) dimer SG3199. ABT-700-SG3199 exhibited superior potency and efficacy in CRC models compared to the clinical-stage MET-targeting ADCs ABBV-399 and ABBV-400, which use the same antibody backbone conjugated to different payloads. Treatment with ABT-700-SG3199 increased LGR5 expression, and the combination of ABT-700-SG3199 with 8E11-CPT2 enhanced CRC cell-killing efficacy, reinforcing the rationale for a dual-targeting approach. In patient-derived xenografts, combined administration of 8E11-CPT2 and ABT-700-SG3199 markedly delayed tumor relapse and prolonged survival compared with single-agent treatment. Taken together, these findings reveal a reciprocal regulation between MET and LGR5 in response to LGR5- or MET-targeting ADCs in CRC models and support a LGR5/MET dual-targeting therapeutic strategy to enhance efficacy and potentially overcome resistance and relapse.
items.summary_zh: Preprint：研究设计了靶向 LGR5 和 MET、使用不同 payloads 的抗体药物偶联物组合，并在结直肠癌细胞、模型和 patient-derived xenografts 中评估其抑制复发的效果。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究提供了细胞机制、药物工程和 patient-derived xenograft 证据，支持通过互补靶向应对 LGR5 下调相关的复发；目前仍属于临床前证据。
items.abstract_zh: 富含亮氨酸重复序列的 G 蛋白偶联受体 5（LGR5）是癌症干样细胞的标志物，在结直肠癌（CRC）中经常上调，而在正常组织中的表达较低，因此是抗体药物偶联物（ADC）的有利靶点。ADC 将抗体特异性与强效细胞毒性 payload 结合，以增强疗效并减少全身毒性。含有不同 payload 的 LGR5 靶向 ADC 显示出强烈的初始肿瘤抑制作用，但肿瘤最终会复发，部分原因是 LGR5 下调，因此需要更有效的策略来防止复发。我们显示，在 CRC 细胞中，化疗或连接拓扑异构酶 1 抑制剂 payload（8E11-CPT2）的 LGR5 靶向 ADC 治疗会降低 LGR5 水平并增加 MET 受体的表达和/或激活，从而支持同时靶向 LGR5 和 MET 的治疗策略。为此，我们通过位点特异性偶联，将抗 MET 抗体 telisotuzumab（ABT-700）与 DNA 交联型 pyrrolobenzodiazepine（PBD）二聚体 SG3199 偶联，构建了 MET 靶向 ADC（ABT-700-SG3199）。与临床阶段的 MET 靶向 ADC ABBV-399 和 ABBV-400 相比，ABT-700-SG3199 在 CRC 模型中表现出更强的效力和疗效；这两种对照药使用相同的抗体骨架，但偶联了不同的 payload。ABT-700-SG3199 治疗增加了 LGR5 表达，而 ABT-700-SG3199 与 8E11-CPT2 联用增强了 CRC 细胞杀伤效果，进一步支持双靶向策略。在 patient-derived xenografts 中，与单药治疗相比，联合给予 8E11-CPT2 和 ABT-700-SG3199 显著延迟了肿瘤复发并延长了生存期。总的来说，这些结果揭示了在 CRC 模型中，LGR5 或 MET 靶向 ADC 反应过程中 MET 与 LGR5 的相互调节，并支持 LGR5/MET 双靶向治疗策略，以增强疗效并可能克服耐药和复发。
items.author_line: Subramanian, S., High, P. C., Guernsey-Biddle, C., Cappellino, M. G., Sullivan, S. P., Liang, Z., Aldana, A. M., Li, L., Pan, S., Carmon, K. S.

items.title: Machine Learning and Large Language Models for Maternal Cardiometabolic Risk Prediction Across Harmonised Public Pregnancy Datasets
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background Pregnancy-related cardiometabolic complications remain important contributors to adverse maternal and fetal outcomes. However, risk-prediction models developed from a single dataset often have limited transportability, and the role of large language models in maternal risk stratification remains unclear. Methods We used two publicly available datasets: the Maternal Health Risk dataset and the Preeclampsia in Pregnant Women dataset. Low-risk, mid-risk, and high-risk labels were harmonised, and a binary high-risk versus non-high-risk endpoint was constructed. We compared several machine-learning models and undertook internal cross-validation, external validation, calibration, decision-curve analysis, and sensitivity analyses. Structured records were subsequently converted into label-free case narratives; DeepSeek and Qwen were evaluated under different prompting strategies, and the concordance between keywords in large language model explanations and machine-learning feature importance was examined. Results In internal validation, HistGradientBoosting showed the strongest overall performance, with a macro-averaged F1 score of approximately 0.876. Performance declined in external validation, in which multiclass accuracy was approximately 0.389. Across sensitivity analyses, the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve ranged from 0.437 to 0.528. Among the large language model configurations, Qwen with few-shot chain-of-thought prompting performed best, with an accuracy of approximately 0.583 and a macro-averaged F1 score of approximately 0.467. Explanatory keywords generated by the large language models most often concerned blood glucose or diabetes, blood pressure or hypertension, haemoglobin or anaemia, previous complications or medical history, and proteinuria. Conclusion We developed an integrated framework for maternal cardiometabolic risk prediction that combines feature harmonisation, conventional machine learning, external validation, and large language model explanations. Machine-learning models performed well internally but generalised poorly across datasets. Large language models showed some ability to assess risk from case text and generate readable clinical explanations, but require validation in larger, multicentre, prospective studies.
items.summary_zh: Preprint：研究整合两个公开妊娠数据集，比较传统机器学习与 DeepSeek、Qwen 在孕产妇心脏代谢风险分层中的表现，并进行外部验证和校准分析。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 同时揭示模型的内部性能与跨数据集泛化落差；结果支持进一步验证，而不支持直接用于临床风险分层。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 妊娠相关心脏代谢并发症仍然是孕产妇和胎儿不良结局的重要原因。然而，基于单一数据集开发的风险预测模型通常可迁移性有限，大型语言模型在孕产妇风险分层中的作用仍不明确。方法 我们使用了两个公开数据集：Maternal Health Risk dataset 和 Preeclampsia in Pregnant Women dataset。我们对低风险、中风险和高风险标签进行了协调，并构建了高风险与非高风险二分类终点。我们比较了多种机器学习模型，并开展内部交叉验证、外部验证、校准、决策曲线分析和敏感性分析。随后，我们将结构化记录转换为无标签病例叙述，在不同提示策略下评估 DeepSeek 和 Qwen，并考察大型语言模型解释中的关键词与机器学习特征重要性之间的一致性。结果 在内部验证中，HistGradientBoosting 的总体表现最强，宏平均 F1 分数约为 0.876。在外部验证中，性能下降，多分类准确率约为 0.389。在敏感性分析中，受试者工作特征曲线下面积为 0.437 至 0.528。在大型语言模型配置中，采用 few-shot chain-of-thought prompting 的 Qwen 表现最好，准确率约为 0.583，宏平均 F1 分数约为 0.467。大型语言模型生成的解释性关键词最常涉及血糖或糖尿病、血压或高血压、血红蛋白或贫血、既往并发症或病史，以及 proteinuria。结论 我们开发了一个整合框架，将特征协调、传统机器学习、外部验证和大型语言模型解释结合起来，用于孕产妇心脏代谢风险预测。机器学习模型在内部表现良好，但跨数据集泛化较差。大型语言模型显示出根据病例文本评估风险并生成可读临床解释的一定能力，但仍需要在更大规模、多中心、前瞻性研究中验证。
items.author_line: Wen S, Tang Y, Ma B, Cao B, Deng Z

items.title: Deep learning integrated clinical-radiomics model for prognostic prediction in locally advanced cervical cancer through 18 F-FDG PET/CT and MRI combination
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background Precise pretreatment risk stratification is critical for guiding treatment intensification and personalized follow‑up in patients with locally advanced cervical cancer (LACC) after concurrent chemoradiotherapy (CCRT). This study developed and validated a deep learning integrated clinical-radiomics model for prognosis prediction in patients with LACC treated with CCRT, using dual-modal pretreatment imaging from 18 F-FDG PET/CT and contrast-enhanced MRI. Methods We retrospectively collected 346 patients (276 for training and 70 for testing) with LACC between June 2016 and October 2021. Radiomics and deep learning signatures were extracted from PET/CT and MRI. These signatures were integrated with the clinicopathological factors into a nomogram for clinical applications. Models were constructed using eleven machine learning algorithms, and a clinical-radiomics-deep learning model (CRDLM) was developed. The evaluation of the model’s performance was conducted through the metrics of the area under the curve (AUC). Results The CRDLM demonstrated superior predictive performance (AUCs of 0.998 (95% CI: 1.00–1.00) for training cohort and 0.901 (95% CI: 0.83–0.97) for testing cohort), which is significantly superior to conventional clinical factors (FIGO stage and SCC-Ag, AUC = 0.605–0.658). In addition, the CRDLM which combined radiomics with deep learning significantly outperformed the radiomics‑only model (AUC = 0.793, p = 0.006). Sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy of CRDLM reached 0.947, 0.725, and 0.786, respectively. Conclusions The CRDLM provides robust prediction of disease progression in LACC patients who received CCRT, which may facilitate personalized treatment strategies and improve clinical outcomes. Further validation in multicenter prospective studies is warranted.
items.summary_zh: Preprint：基于 18 F-FDG PET/CT 和增强 MRI，研究构建并测试融合临床因素、radiomics 和 deep learning 的局部晚期宫颈癌预后模型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 样本含 346 例并设置独立测试集，模型测试 AUC 达 0.901；但研究为回顾性且仍需多中心前瞻性验证。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 对于接受同步放化疗（CCRT）的局部晚期宫颈癌（LACC）患者，治疗前精准风险分层对于指导治疗强化和个体化随访至关重要。本研究使用 18 F-FDG PET/CT 和增强 MRI 的双模态治疗前影像，开发并验证一个整合 deep learning 的临床-radiomics 模型，用于接受 CCRT 的 LACC 患者预后预测。方法 我们回顾性收集了 2016 年 6 月至 2021 年 10 月期间的 346 例 LACC 患者，其中 276 例用于训练，70 例用于测试。从 PET/CT 和 MRI 中提取 radiomics 和 deep learning signatures，并将这些 signatures 与临床病理因素整合进用于临床应用的列线图。模型通过 11 种机器学习算法构建，并开发了 clinical-radiomics-deep learning model（CRDLM）。模型性能通过曲线下面积（AUC）评估。结果 CRDLM 显示出优异的预测性能：训练队列的 AUC 为 0.998（95% CI: 1.00–1.00），测试队列的 AUC 为 0.901（95% CI: 0.83–0.97），显著优于传统临床因素（FIGO stage 和 SCC-Ag，AUC = 0.605–0.658）。此外，融合 radiomics 与 deep learning 的 CRDLM 显著优于仅使用 radiomics 的模型（AUC = 0.793，p = 0.006）。CRDLM 的敏感度、特异度和准确率分别达到 0.947、0.725 和 0.786。结论 CRDLM 能够稳健预测接受 CCRT 的 LACC 患者疾病进展，可能有助于制定个体化治疗策略并改善临床结局。仍需开展多中心前瞻性研究进行进一步验证。
items.author_line: Song J, Chen K, Cai Y, Yi H

items.title: Artificial Intelligence for Liver Disease Prediction: A Systematic Review and an Explainable Hybrid Ensemble with Automated Clinical Feature Engineering
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Liver disease prediction using routine clinical biomarkers is a common medical artificial-intelligence problem, there are significant variations in reported performance on the Indian Liver Patient Dataset (ILPD) and these differences stem from variations in preprocessing, feature selection, class balancing, validation and leakage control. This study integrates a DOI verified systematic evidence review, a reproducible experimental benchmark and an explainable hybrid ensemble. Structured data studies published between 2020 and September 2026 that include a DOI were synthesized, especially for the current focus of the research on ILPD. All 583 ILPD records (of 416 liver-disease and 167 non-disease cases) were used in the experimental component. The data-quality analysis, followed by false-discovery-rate (FDR) corrected group testing, repeated stratified cross-validation and by duplicate-sensitivity analysis were followed by nested 5×3-fold model development. Four complementary learners extra trees, LightGBM, Gaussian Naive Bayes and logistic regression were stacked with leakage safe out-of-fold stacking and sigmoid calibration. An automated clinical feature-engineering module expanded the 10 original predictors to a 24-feature candidate pool using clinically interpretable ratios, composite biomarkers, and log transformations; mutual-information feature selection was tuned strictly inside training folds. In the systematic review, DOI-verified studies reported headline accuracies ranging from approximately 71% to 99.6%, but evaluation protocols were highly heterogeneous. In our leakage-aware experiment, automated feature engineering improved ROC-AUC from 0.744 to 0.761 and PR-AUC from 0.893 to 0.897. Under a balanced-accuracy threshold, the engineered model achieved 64.8% accuracy, 71.2% balanced accuracy, 56.3% sensitivity, 86.2% specificity, and 0.761 ROC-AUC. Under a training-only sensitivity-constrained threshold, it achieved 69.5% accuracy, 78.1% sensitivity, 47.9% specificity, F1 = 0.785, and MCC = 0.258. Age, ALT, AST, indirect bilirubin, bilirubin burden, ALT + AST, and log-transformed bilirubin/aminotransferases were selected in every nested-CV model-fit. The findings show that automated clinical feature engineering improves discrimination and screening trade-offs, while also demonstrating that very high headline accuracy on small tabular medical datasets should be interpreted in the context of validation design and leakage control.
items.summary_zh: Preprint：研究在 583 条 ILPD 记录上结合系统综述、泄漏控制、嵌套交叉验证和可解释混合集成模型，评估自动临床特征工程对肝病预测的影响。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 重点展示了小型表格医学数据中验证设计和数据泄漏控制对性能解读的影响，并提供了可复现实验基准。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 使用常规临床生物标志物进行肝病预测是常见的医学人工智能问题；在 Indian Liver Patient Dataset（ILPD）上，报告的性能存在显著差异，而这些差异源于预处理、特征选择、类别平衡、验证和泄漏控制方面的不同。本研究整合了 DOI 验证的系统证据综述、可复现实验基准和可解释混合集成模型。我们综合了 2020 年至 2026 年 9 月期间发表且包含 DOI 的结构化数据研究，重点关注当前研究所使用的 ILPD。实验部分使用了全部 583 条 ILPD 记录（其中 416 例为肝病病例，167 例为非肝病病例）。在数据质量分析之后，我们进行了 FDR 校正的组间检验、重复分层交叉验证和重复敏感性分析，随后开展嵌套 5×3 折模型开发。四种互补学习器——extra trees、LightGBM、Gaussian Naive Bayes 和 logistic regression——通过防止泄漏的 out-of-fold stacking 和 sigmoid calibration 进行堆叠。自动临床特征工程模块使用具有临床可解释性的比值、复合生物标志物和对数变换，将 10 个原始预测变量扩展为 24 个候选特征；互信息特征选择严格在训练折内调节。在系统综述中，经过 DOI 验证的研究报告的标题准确率约为 71% 至 99.6%，但评估方案高度异质。在控制泄漏的实验中，自动特征工程使 ROC-AUC 从 0.744 提高到 0.761，使 PR-AUC 从 0.893 提高到 0.897。在平衡准确率阈值下，工程化模型达到 64.8% 准确率、71.2% 平衡准确率、56.3% 敏感度、86.2% 特异度和 0.761 ROC-AUC。在仅使用训练集确定的敏感度约束阈值下，模型达到 69.5% 准确率、78.1% 敏感度、47.9% 特异度、F1 = 0.785 和 MCC = 0.258。在每次嵌套交叉验证模型拟合中，Age、ALT、AST、indirect bilirubin、bilirubin burden、ALT + AST 以及 bilirubin/aminotransferases 的对数变换均被选中。结果表明，自动临床特征工程改善了区分能力和筛查权衡，同时也说明，小型表格医学数据集上的极高标题准确率应结合验证设计和泄漏控制来解读。

items.title: Re-evaluating the benefit of pretraining scale in cell foundation models
items.abstract_or_text: Single-cell foundation models are self-supervised neural networks pretrained on millions of cellular transcriptomes to learn representations that transfer across biological domains and downstream tasks. Recent benchmarks have questioned the training data scaling law for these models, showing early finetuning performance saturation on a fraction of available pretraining data. However, whether this trend holds for larger second-generation foundation models, and whether it reflects genuine saturation of foundation representations remains unclear. To resolve these aspects, we tested the performance of second- and first-generation cell foundation models across corpus sizes using the standard finetuning approach, and extended it with a comprehensive fully frozen evaluation. We revealed that the training-data scaling relationship becomes apparent under fully frozen finetuning, particularly for second-generation models. Zero-shot analyses similarly recovered dependence on pretraining scale. We conclude that finetuning performance saturation does not imply biological representations saturation, and that a shift in standards of cell foundation model evaluation is needed, complementing standard finetuning with fully frozen benchmarking to capture the quality of the foundation representations.
items.summary_zh: Preprint：研究比较不同预训练语料规模下第一代和第二代单细胞 foundation models 的微调、冻结和 zero-shot 表现，指出微调饱和不等于表示学习饱和。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 对细胞基础模型的评估提出了可操作的修正：需要加入 fully frozen benchmarking，才能更好衡量预训练表示本身的质量。
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞 foundation models 是在数百万细胞转录组上进行预训练的自监督神经网络，旨在学习能够迁移到不同生物学领域和下游任务的表示。近期基准研究对这些模型的训练数据 scaling law 提出了质疑，显示仅使用一部分可用预训练数据时，微调性能就会较早饱和。然而，这一趋势是否适用于规模更大的第二代 foundation models，以及它是否反映了基础表示的真正饱和，仍不清楚。为了解决这些问题，我们使用标准微调方法，按照不同语料规模测试了第二代和第一代细胞 foundation models 的性能，并扩展到全面的 fully frozen evaluation。我们发现，训练数据规模关系在 fully frozen finetuning 下变得明显，尤其是在第二代模型中。Zero-shot 分析同样恢复了对预训练规模的依赖。我们得出结论：微调性能饱和并不意味着生物学表示饱和；细胞 foundation model 的评估标准需要转变，将标准微调与 fully frozen benchmarking 结合，以捕捉基础表示的质量。
items.author_line: Shakeel, M. H., Shen, M., Mangiola, S.

items.title: Functional fine-mapping of the 9p21.3 cardiovascular disease locus implicates the lncRNA MIR31HG as an effector transcript in endothelial cells
items.abstract_or_text: BACKGROUND: The chromosome 9p21.3 locus is among the strongest genetic risk loci for cardiovascular disease (CVD), yet the regulatory mechanisms underlying this association remain poorly understood. Previous vascular disease studies focused predominantly on the role of this locus in smooth muscle cell (SMC) dysfunction, whereas its potential role in endothelial cells (ECs) remains less well characterized. Here, we sought to identify candidate regulatory variants at 9p21.3, their distal target genes, and effector transcripts that contribute to CVD-related phenotypes in ECs. METHODS: Promoter capture Hi-C was used to map chromatin interactions at 9p21.3 in primary human ascending aortic SMCs (n=6), supplementing the previously obtained ECs (n=16) dataset. To support the regulatory relevance of these interactions, expression quantitative trait locus analysis was performed in 136 vascular biopsies. Variant effects were prioritized in silico using AlphaGenome. The regulatory activity of the prioritized region was validated using CRISPR activation. RESULTS: Chromatin interaction mapping identified a complex regulatory architecture at the 9p21.3 locus involving 19 putative regulatory elements and 15 genes across ECs and SMCs. MIR31HG showed the most recurrent distal promoter connectivity with the 9p21.3 region. Consistent with the chromatin interaction map, expression of MIR31HG transcripts was associated with genetic variation at the 9p21.3 locus. In ECs, the lncRNA MIR31HG, but not miR-31, was responsive to hemodynamic flow. Depletion of MIR31HG in ECs was associated with endothelial activation. Epigenetic tracks and deep learning predictions highlighted an active enhancer element at 9p21.3, which was subsequently validated by CRISPR activation and increased MIR31HG expression, confirming its capacity to regulate MIR31HG over a large genomic distance of approximately 538 kb. CONCLUSIONS: Altogether, these data implicate lncRNA MIR31HG as a likely effector of the 9p21.3 CVD locus, linking the cis-regulatory element and heritable genetic variation in the respective region to endothelial activation through long-range enhancer regulation.
items.summary_zh: Preprint：通过 promoter capture Hi-C、eQTL、AlphaGenome 和 CRISPR activation，研究将 9p21.3 心血管疾病风险位点与内皮细胞中的 lncRNA MIR31HG 调控联系起来。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结合人类血管样本、染色质互作和功能验证，提出 MIR31HG 可能是该风险位点的效应转录本；结论仍是机制线索而非已证实因果链。
items.abstract_zh: 背景 染色体 9p21.3 位点是心血管疾病（CVD）最强的遗传风险位点之一，但其关联背后的调控机制仍未得到充分理解。既往血管疾病研究主要聚焦于该位点在平滑肌细胞（SMC）功能障碍中的作用，而其在内皮细胞（EC）中的潜在作用研究较少。这里，我们旨在鉴定 9p21.3 的候选调控变异、其远端靶基因，以及在 EC 中促成 CVD 相关表型的效应转录本。方法 我们使用 promoter capture Hi-C，在原代 human ascending aortic SMCs（n=6）中绘制 9p21.3 的染色质互作图，并补充此前获得的 ECs（n=16）数据集。为支持这些互作的调控相关性，我们在 136 份血管活检样本中进行了 expression quantitative trait locus 分析。我们使用 AlphaGenome 在计算机模拟中对变异效应进行优先级排序，并使用 CRISPR activation 验证优先区域的调控活性。结果 染色质互作图显示，9p21.3 位点包含复杂的调控结构，在 ECs 和 SMCs 中涉及 19 个推定调控元件和 15 个基因。MIR31HG 与 9p21.3 区域的远端启动子连接最为反复出现。与染色质互作图一致，MIR31HG 转录本的表达与 9p21.3 位点的遗传变异相关。在 ECs 中，lncRNA MIR31HG（而非 miR-31）对血流动力学流动有响应。ECs 中 MIR31HG 的耗竭与内皮激活相关。表观遗传轨迹和 deep learning 预测突出显示 9p21.3 的一个活性 enhancer 元件；随后通过 CRISPR activation 验证该元件，并观察到 MIR31HG 表达增加，确认其能够跨越约 538 kb 的基因组距离调控 MIR31HG。结论 总体而言，这些数据提示 lncRNA MIR31HG 很可能是 9p21.3 CVD 位点的效应因子，将该区域的 cis-regulatory element 和可遗传变异与通过远距离 enhancer 调控导致的内皮激活联系起来。
items.author_line: Zhigulev, A., Poujade, F.-A., Gryzunov, N., Buyan, A., Li, H., Bergman, O., Liu, M., Pradhananga, S., Franco-Cereceda, A., Swoboda, P., Kulakovskiy, I. V., Eriksson, P., Sahlen, P., Björck, H. M.

items.title: PigGPA: A Domain-Constrained Agent for Porcine Genomic Breeding with Verifiable Tool Execution
items.abstract_or_text: Large language model agents can plan and execute scientific analyses, but successful task completion does not establish whether analytical decisions remain consistent across independent sessions or whether computations follow the parameters specified beforehand. We investigated these limitations using four genomic analysis tasks. General-purpose agents showed limited consistency in analytical decisions across repeated sessions (57.5-58.8%). Incorporating domain knowledge improved analytical performance, with reusable skills increasing mean evaluation scores from 73.44 to 89.06/100 , but did not resolve decision variability or ensure agreement between specified and executed parameters. To address these limitations, we developed an approach combining domain-constrained analytical skills with call-level execution contracts. Each tool invocation is linked to a pre-execution parameter declaration through SHA-256 hashing, with actual command-line arguments and execution records subsequently checked against the declared parameters. We implemented this approach in PigGPA, an autonomous agent for porcine genomic breeding that integrates statistical genetics, sequence-based functional prediction and multi-omics annotation. PigGPA completed all benchmark tasks with full agreement between declared and executed parameters, while its core quantitative-genetic results closely matched established software (r = 0.999-1.000). An application to loin muscle depth further demonstrated an integrated workflow from genetic association analysis to functional interpretation. These findings show that domain knowledge improves analytical performance, while direct verification of tool execution provides an additional basis for reproducible scientific computation.
items.summary_zh: Preprint：PigGPA 将领域约束技能、统计遗传学、序列功能预测和多组学注释结合，并用 SHA-256 哈希把工具调用与预执行参数声明绑定，以验证代理分析是否按既定参数执行。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在猪基因组育种任务中实现了声明参数与实际执行参数的完全一致，核心定量遗传结果与成熟软件相关系数 r = 0.999-1.000，直接回应了科学代理的可复现性问题。
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型代理能够规划并执行科学分析，但任务成功完成并不能说明分析决策在独立会话之间保持一致，也不能说明计算遵循了预先指定的参数。我们使用四项基因组分析任务研究了这些局限。通用代理在重复会话中的分析决策一致性有限（57.5-58.8%）。加入领域知识提高了分析性能，可复用技能使平均评估得分从 73.44 提高到 89.06/100，但没有解决决策变异性，也不能确保指定参数与执行参数一致。为解决这些问题，我们提出一种将领域约束分析技能与调用级执行契约相结合的方法。每次工具调用都通过 SHA-256 哈希与预执行参数声明关联，随后检查实际命令行参数和执行记录是否符合声明参数。我们据此实现 PigGPA，这是一个用于猪基因组育种的自主代理，整合了统计遗传学、基于序列的功能预测和多组学注释。PigGPA 完成了全部基准任务，声明参数与执行参数完全一致，其核心定量遗传结果与成熟软件高度吻合（r = 0.999-1.000）。对 loin muscle depth 的应用进一步展示了从遗传关联分析到功能解释的整合流程。这些结果表明，领域知识能够提高分析性能，而对工具执行进行直接验证则为可复现科学计算提供了额外依据。
items.author_line: Liang, C., Zhang, Y., Wei, W., Wang, Z., Li, K.

items.title: NeuroPilot: Longitudinal intravital neural imaging across scales and modalities through an agentic platform
items.abstract_or_text: Longitudinal intravital imaging is essential for understanding how neural populations evolve across behavioral states, yet converting large-scale recordings into biological insight remains a fundamental challenge because neural signals are degraded by noise, non-rigid motion, and heterogeneous recording conditions. Here we introduce NeuroPilot, an agentic framework that transforms neural imaging analysis into a closed-loop, context-aware process, integrating a multimodal large language model with callable computational imaging modules to adaptively coordinate workflows from raw recordings to population-level readouts. Across heterogeneous imaging and experimental regimes, NeuroPilot restores motion-degraded recordings and supports consistent neural signal recovery, detection, and tracking in challenging deep-brain, freely moving, and longitudinal settings. These enable neuronal population tracking across spinal stimulation paradigms, deep-brain imaging, and continuous 24-hour mPFC recordings aligned with spontaneous sleep-wake behavior. By converting heterogeneous intravital recordings into stable population activity maps, NeuroPilot supports behavioral decoding and reveals structured neural dynamics across behavioral states and transitions. NeuroPilot establishes a scalable agentic paradigm for neural imaging analysis, expanding experimental access to the measurement, visualization, and interpretation of neural population activity.
items.summary_zh: Preprint：NeuroPilot 将多模态大型语言模型与可调用的计算成像模块结合，形成闭环、具备上下文感知的纵向活体神经成像分析平台。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 覆盖深脑、自由活动和长时程记录，并展示从运动校正到神经元群体跟踪与行为解码的连续流程，体现了代理式科学分析平台的可扩展方向。
items.abstract_zh: 纵向活体成像对于理解神经群体如何随行为状态演变至关重要，但由于神经信号受到噪声、非刚性运动和异质记录条件的影响，将大规模记录转化为生物学洞见仍是根本性挑战。这里我们介绍 NeuroPilot，这是一种代理式框架，将神经成像分析转化为闭环、具备上下文感知的过程；它整合多模态大型语言模型与可调用的计算成像模块，自适应地协调从原始记录到群体层面读出的工作流。在异质成像和实验条件下，NeuroPilot 修复受运动影响的记录，并支持在具有挑战性的深脑、自由活动和纵向场景中稳定地恢复、检测和跟踪神经信号。这些能力支持在脊髓刺激范式、深脑成像以及与自发睡眠-觉醒行为对齐的连续 24 小时 mPFC 记录中跟踪神经元群体。通过将异质活体记录转化为稳定的群体活动图，NeuroPilot 支持行为解码，并揭示不同行为状态及状态转换中的结构化神经动态。NeuroPilot 建立了一种可扩展的代理式神经成像分析范式，扩大了对神经元群体活动进行测量、可视化和解释的实验可及性。
items.author_line: Zhang, G., Luo, Y., Ju, F., Liu, D., Zhang, D., Guo, C., Han, J., Qiu, S., Wang, T., Wang, J., Ma, M., Li, B., Jiang, Y., Wei, P., Liu, X., Chi, N., Li, Z.

items.title: Friedreich Ataxia iPSC-derived microglia display an interferon-responsive, antigen-presenting, and inflammasome-associated state with lysosomal biology and extracellular matrix abnormalities
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Friedreich Ataxia (FRDA) is an autosomal recessive neurodegenerative disorder characterized by progressive loss of neurons that control movement and coordination. In most patients, FRDA is caused by homozygous GAA trinucleotide repeat expansions in the first intron of the frataxin ( FXN ) gene, resulting in reduced expression of frataxin, a mitochondrial protein essential for biogenesis of iron-sulfur clusters and mitochondrial function. Effective disease-modifying treatments remain lacking for FRDA. Increasing evidence indicates that microglial cell dysfunction contributes to FRDA pathogenesis, highlighting these cells as potential therapeutic targets. However, the molecular mechanisms underlying FXN-deficient microglial dysfunction remain poorly understood. Here, we sought to address this gap in knowledge. Microglia were generated from FRDA patient-derived iPSCs under naïve conditions and alterations in gene and protein expression, compared to isogenic microglia, were characterized by bulk RNA sequencing and secretome analysis. FXN-deficient microglia exhibit a cell-autonomous interferon-responsive and antigen-presenting pro-inflammatory phenotype. This pro-inflammatory state is characterized by coordinated activation of immune transcriptional programs, dysregulated secretion of neuroinflammatory proteins, activation of inflammasomes involving NLRP2 and NLRP3, and abnormalities of lysosomal homeostasis, autophagic flux, and extracellular matrix composition. These findings demonstrate that FXN deficiency is sufficient to induce intrinsic microglial activation and identify molecular pathways that may represent attractive targets for future FRDA therapies.
items.summary_zh: Preprint：研究用患者来源 iPSC 分化的 microglia 与同基因背景对照比较 FRDA 相关的转录、蛋白分泌、炎症小体、溶酶体和细胞外基质变化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果支持 FXN 缺陷可在 microglia 中引发细胞自主的促炎状态，并为 FRDA 的潜在治疗通路提供分子线索；尚不能等同于患者体内疗效。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 Friedreich Ataxia（FRDA）是一种常染色体隐性神经退行性疾病，其特征是控制运动和协调的神经元进行性丧失。在大多数患者中，FRDA 由 frataxin（FXN）基因第一内含子中的纯合 GAA 三核苷酸重复扩增引起，导致 frataxin 表达降低；frataxin 是一种对铁-硫簇生物发生和线粒体功能至关重要的线粒体蛋白。FRDA 仍缺乏有效的疾病修饰治疗。越来越多的证据表明，microglia 功能障碍参与 FRDA 发病机制，使这些细胞成为潜在治疗靶点。然而，FXN 缺陷导致 microglia 功能障碍的分子机制仍知之甚少。这里我们旨在弥补这一知识缺口。我们在 naïve 条件下由 FRDA 患者来源的 iPSCs 生成 microglia，并通过 bulk RNA sequencing 和 secretome analysis，与同基因背景 microglia 进行比较，表征基因和蛋白表达变化。FXN-deficient microglia 表现出细胞自主的 interferon-responsive 和 antigen-presenting 促炎表型。这种促炎状态的特征包括免疫转录程序协调激活、神经炎症蛋白分泌失调、涉及 NLRP2 和 NLRP3 的炎症小体激活，以及溶酶体稳态、自噬通量和细胞外基质组成异常。这些发现表明，FXN 缺陷足以诱导 microglia 的内在激活，并确定了可能成为未来 FRDA 治疗有吸引力靶点的分子通路。
items.author_line: Tang YM, Lo R, Thiry L, Fiorini M, Farhan S, Pandolfo M, Stifani S

items.title: Genetic Perturbation Prediction Models Fail Out-of-Distribution: A Rigorous Benchmark and Systematic Evaluation
items.abstract_or_text: Perturbation prediction models - which forecast transcriptional responses to gene inactivation - are increasingly proposed as in silico surrogates for genome-scale drug discovery screens. Yet, rigorous evaluation of whether these models genuinely generalize beyond their training distribution has been lacking. Existing benchmarks rely predominantly on random train-test splits, obscuring systematic failure modes that only emerge under realistic out-of-distribution (OOD) conditions. Here we introduce EL-PERTURB (Extrapolative Learning for PERTURBation Prediction), a benchmarking framework that stress-tests 20 perturbation prediction models spanning six architecture classes on both essential gene and genome-wide Perturb-seq screens, using a novel stratified OOD splitting strategy that partitions train and test sets into functionally distinct regions of transcriptional space. We find that model performance degrades substantially under OOD conditions, and that architectural complexity - including single-cell foundation model embeddings - confers no reliable advantage over well-tuned simpler baselines. EL-PERTURB establishes a rigorous benchmark for perturbation effect prediction across a gradient of generalization difficulty, providing a guide for building models that can genuinely serve as surrogates for wet-lab screening.
items.summary_zh: Preprint：EL-PERTURB 在 essential gene 和 genome-wide Perturb-seq 数据上，以分层的 out-of-distribution 切分严格评估 20 个基因扰动预测模型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果显示真实 OOD 条件下模型性能显著下降，复杂架构和 single-cell foundation model embeddings 未稳定优于调优后的简单基线，为体外筛选替代模型设定了更严格的评估标准。
items.abstract_zh: 基因扰动预测模型用于预测基因失活后的转录响应，越来越多地被提出作为基因组尺度药物发现筛选的计算替代物。然而，关于这些模型是否真正能够超越训练分布进行泛化，仍缺乏严格评估。现有基准主要依赖随机训练-测试划分，掩盖了只有在真实的 out-of-distribution（OOD）条件下才会出现的系统性失败模式。这里我们提出 EL-PERTURB（Extrapolative Learning for PERTURBation Prediction），一种基准框架，使用新的分层 OOD 切分策略，将训练集和测试集划分到转录空间中功能不同的区域，并在 essential gene 和全基因组 Perturb-seq 筛选上对六类架构的 20 个扰动预测模型进行压力测试。我们发现，在 OOD 条件下模型性能显著下降；包括 single-cell foundation model embeddings 在内的架构复杂性，并未相对于经过良好调优的简单基线带来可靠优势。EL-PERTURB 建立了一个沿泛化难度梯度评估扰动效应预测的严格基准，为构建真正能够作为湿实验筛选替代物的模型提供了指南。
items.author_line: Tiwari, K., Mahajan, G., Bellad, R. P., Dhruw, N. K., Jha, A. K.

items.title: Behavioral and neural modulation effects of transcranial pulse stimulation of the dorsal cingulate cortex and anterior insula cortex in healthy adults: A prospective, randomized, sham-controlled trial
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background Transcranial pulse stimulation (TPS) is a novel non-invasive brain stimulation technique with promising neuromodulation effects. No studies have examined target-specific deep brain TPS. This study assessed whether TPS of the dorsal anterior cingulate cortex (dACC) and anterior insular cortex (AIC) modulates risk-taking behavior and brain circuits in healthy participants. Methods Seventy-five healthy adults were randomized in this subjects/raters-blind study to 10 sessions of active dACC-TPS, active AIC-TPS, or sham-TPS over 2 weeks. Balloon Analog Risk Task (BART), a psychological measure of risk-taking behavior with high ecological validity, was assessed at baseline, midpoint (Week 1), and endpoint (Week 2). Resting-state functional connectivity (rsFC) was measured at baseline and endpoint. Results Most participants experienced mild-to-moderate adverse events, primarily tingling and pain at the stimulation site. The overall dropout rate was 4%. Significant interactions emerged in the BART: dACC-TPS significantly decreased average pumps (average pumps on all trials), AIC-TPS significantly increased adjusted average pumps (average pumps on trials where the balloon did not burst), and sham showed no change. Target-specific rsFC changes were observed following active stimulation versus sham: dACC-TPS predominantly enhanced rsFC of dACC and AIC with precuneus, parietal, and occipital cortices, whereas AIC-TPS decreased rsFC of AIC with striatum. Conclusions Ten sessions of dACC-TPS and AIC-TPS are feasible and safe. dACC-TPS decreased risk-taking behavior, whereas AIC-TPS increased it. Bidirectional, target-specific rsFC changes were observed. Future large-scale studies with online neuroimaging or neurophysiological investigations are needed to confirm short- and long-term efficacy and clarify underlying mechanisms. Trial Registration ClinicalTrial.gov Identifier NCT06635161.
items.summary_zh: Preprint：这项前瞻性、随机、sham 对照试验在 75 名健康成年人中比较 dACC-TPS、AIC-TPS 和 sham-TPS 对风险决策行为与静息态功能连接的影响。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 提供了靶点特异性的随机对照和试验注册信息，但样本量小、对象为健康人，结论主要涉及可行性和短期神经行为变化。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 经颅脉冲刺激（TPS）是一种新型非侵入性脑刺激技术，具有潜在的神经调节作用。此前尚无研究考察靶点特异性的深部脑 TPS。本研究评估了对背侧前扣带皮层（dACC）和前岛叶皮层（AIC）进行 TPS 是否会调节健康参与者的风险行为和脑回路。方法 在受试者/评定者盲法研究中，75 名健康成年人被随机分配至 active dACC-TPS、active AIC-TPS 或 sham-TPS 组，在 2 周内接受 10 次刺激。于基线、第 1 周中点和第 2 周终点评估 Balloon Analog Risk Task（BART）；该心理学测量具有较高的生态效度，用于评估风险承担行为。于基线和终点测量静息态功能连接（rsFC）。结果 大多数参与者经历了轻度至中度不良事件，主要为刺激部位刺痛和疼痛。总体脱落率为 4%。BART 出现显著交互作用：dACC-TPS 显著降低平均充气次数（所有试次的平均充气次数），AIC-TPS 显著增加调整后的平均充气次数（气球未爆炸试次中的平均充气次数），而 sham 组没有变化。与 sham 相比，active stimulation 后观察到靶点特异性的 rsFC 变化：dACC-TPS 主要增强 dACC 和 AIC 与楔前叶、顶叶和枕叶皮层的 rsFC，而 AIC-TPS 降低 AIC 与纹状体的 rsFC。结论 10 次 dACC-TPS 和 AIC-TPS 在可行性和安全性方面表现良好。dACC-TPS 降低风险承担行为，而 AIC-TPS 增加风险承担行为。研究观察到双向且靶点特异性的 rsFC 变化。未来需要开展更大规模、配合在线神经成像或神经生理学评估的研究，以确认短期和长期疗效并阐明潜在机制。试验注册 ClinicalTrial.gov Identifier NCT06635161。
items.author_line: Qin PP, Chak IK, Lin TTZ, Jin M, Kan RL, Zhang BB, Xia AW, Wang SX, Lam V, Lin J, Yuan T, Chau BK, Bergmann TO, Padberg F, Kranz GS

items.title: A Computational Framework for Understanding HCV Infection and Associated Lipid Dynamics
items.abstract_or_text: Hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection is strongly intertwined with host lipid metabolism and is frequently associated with hepatic steatosis, particularly in genotype-specific cases where lipid accumulation reflects direct viral effects rather than host metabolic comorbidities. Despite extensive clinical and experimental evidence, a quantitative framework capturing the bidirectional coupling between viral dynamics and lipid metabolism remains lacking. In this work, we develop a comprehensive mathematical model that integrates HCV infection dynamics with intracellular lipid regulation. The framework combines a reaction diffusion system for spatial viral spread with a coupled metabolic module describing lipid influx. Numerical simulations highlight the role of lipid feedback in shifting infection outcomes toward persistence and recurrent oscillations, demonstrating that lipid accumulation acts as a critical driver of viral amplification. The model also highlights the critical role of immune memory to study acute and chronic phase and successfully reproduces observed viral RNA trajectories. Overall, the framework provides mechanistic insights into HCV dynamics and offers a general modeling approach for studying virus metabolism interactions in liver disease.
items.summary_zh: Preprint：数学模型将 HCV 反应扩散感染动力学与细胞内脂质调控耦合，用数值模拟分析脂质反馈、病毒持续感染、振荡和免疫记忆。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 提供了病毒动力学与脂质代谢双向耦合的机制化建模框架，但其结论来自模拟和轨迹拟合，不能替代实验因果验证。
items.abstract_zh: 丙型肝炎病毒（HCV）感染与宿主脂质代谢密切交织，并且常与肝脂肪变性相关，尤其是在脂质积累反映病毒直接作用而非宿主代谢共病的基因型特异性情形中。尽管已有大量临床和实验学证据，但能够描述病毒动力学与脂质代谢双向耦合的定量框架仍然缺乏。在本研究中，我们建立了一个综合数学模型，将 HCV 感染动力学与细胞内脂质调控结合起来。该框架将描述病毒空间传播的反应扩散系统，与描述脂质流入的耦合代谢模块结合。数值模拟显示，脂质反馈会使感染结局转向持续感染和反复振荡，表明脂质积累可能是病毒扩增的重要驱动因素。该模型还强调了免疫记忆在研究急性期和慢性期中的关键作用，并成功再现了观察到的病毒 RNA 轨迹。总体而言，该框架为 HCV 动力学提供了机制性洞见，也为研究病毒-代谢相互作用在肝病中的作用提供了一般化建模方法。
items.author_line: Jacoby, A., Ghosh, S., Banerjee, M., Ghosh, A., Volpert, V.
